Class TextPanel3D

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Node

org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.googler.gui.TextPanel3D
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.event.LgEventSource
public class TextPanel3D extends org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Container3D
This is a generic text panel that allow to write text in a matrix of letters, providing an halo effect borrowed from jim zaun's kwebdemo1. You can indicate Halocolor, Fontcolor and BackgroundColor for each line/letter
